symbol.aria-label: Three nested unclosed rings on the night path
A ring gapped by a quarter arc, chips drifting ahead
Two mourners flanking an empty place split by a hard cut
Three rejected metaphors struck by one diagonal cut
symbol.text: old enough to die right away

symbol.aria-label: Five exclusion bars threaded by one unbroken path
A thunderstorm below, three arcs converging above it
A leveled crowd with one hollow face under a flattening rule
A crisp ring and a dissolving ring sharing one gap
A single vertical shaft of light on night ground
A seal ring pressed into a dark tablet among erased rings
Chatter marks broken by one clean vertical cut
The word NICHTS ringed by three broken arcs
A tilted hut under a wide thin arc, cuts rising from the ridge
A plumb line fraying above a descending abyss of rings
A ruled ledger cracking apart against an unruled abyss
A standing figure completing the ring as horizontal light breaks
